blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Alex Eala shoots for a quarterfinal spot in the Pan Pacific Open against Australia’s Talia Gibson. The match will be a first between Eala and Gibson at a WTA Tour-level event. They’ve met twice, but only in lower-tier tournaments under the International Tennis Federation (ITF). READ: Alex Eala eases past teen Mika Stojsavljevic at Pan Pacific Open Eala swept Gibson, 6-3, 6-1, in the W40 Palma del Rio, Spain in June 2023 before beating her again, 4-6, 6-4, 6-3, two months later in the W25 Aldershot, England.
